newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end down as rate worries, weak Dow weigh.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end down as rate worries, weak Dow weigh.

text.p: Leading UK blue chips lost ground on Wednesday after a surprisingly strong UK employment report reignited fears of an interest rate hike, dealers said.
A sharp drop on Wall Street also spooked investors who had watched U.S. shares reach record highs no less than four times this year.
"There certainly are more people looking for a rate hike today than there were yesterday," said one dealer. "But people with long memories realise that a pre-emptive strike isn't a bad idea."
The FTSE 100 ended 9.3 points lower at 4,158.9.
